newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Anglo says c.bank gold sale fears overdone.
newsitem.headline: Anglo says c.bank gold sale fears overdone.

text.p: Recent public debate has exaggerated the risks of central bank sales for the gold market, according Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd, the world's biggest producer.

"We are not that concerned about central bank selling. It will continue to happen but will not have as much of an effect on prices as the public debate," marketing manager Kelvin Williams said at a results presentation.
Physical demand for gold remained strong, he added.

The current debate focuses in particular on the likely behaviour of the European central banks in respect of their gold reserves leading up to the 1998 qualification period envisaged by the Maastricht Treaty for entry into the single European Central Bank in 1999.
